reviews.title: Stop acting smarter than your users
reviews.text: I want to join a specific club but have learned you will not let me search for the club! Are you morons? This is not a more exciting way to shop.

reviews.title: Triggers CC fraud alert
reviews.text:
So it’s not clear that as soon as you put something in your cart, you’re billed for it. 
Which is the antithesis of every online shopping I’ve ever done.
A stated in the title, this triggered a fraud alert from Chase. Dumb. Very Dumb.

Was “can’t search”
Well that seems like an odd way to shop. Just randomly scroll for 10-15 minutes to try and find what you’re looking for, as opposed to seeking it in 12 seconds with a “find” button. Maybe next version….

reviews.title: Montana tavern association is corrupt and needs to be investigate
reviews.text: Screw Tavour for not doing their job, screw Montana legislature for being soulless sellouts and may all the Montana tavern association become penniless and homeless. I hope someone investigates them asap.

reviews.title: Non existent customer service
reviews.text: It’s ok when everything works. Expensive but OK. If, however, you have a problem with your order, good luck trying to get them to pick up the phone or answer an email. As soon as I can figure out how to uninstall the app and opt-out of their email, then I’m sending them straight to the cornfield.

reviews.title: Issues
reviews.text: The app keeps telling me Tavour is not available in my state which is Northern, VA and  it kicks me out. I order from this app all the time and now all of a sudden I cannot.

reviews.title: Good idea, zero tech support.
reviews.text:
I’ve had an issue with the application sending duplicate notifications. I reached out to support over two months ago, and they’ve done nothing. I keep being told it’s being investigated and then radio silence until I follow up again. 
Good beer selection. Good platform for breweries. Bad app + support.

reviews.title: Can’t find Search
reviews.text: Appears to be a controlled curated set of beers. I can’t find a way to search for beers or breweries I know I like. Deal breaker for me
